messages:
sam: Quick preflight 1 listing SKU landed in staging. Two asks: hardware partner needs demo rack (EdgeCloud asked for 3U) and press kit distribution timing.

lina: EdgeCloud confirmed 3U in rack A7 for Thurs demo. Emailing logistics.

kai: Partner-only press kit ready. Plan: partners get kit at T-30m via secure share, embargo lifts at 08:00 PT, public blog at 08:05 PT. OK?

sam: T-30m ok. Make sure hero screenshots in 2:1 and 16:9, PNG+SVG, include cache-bust param for last-minute edits.

lina: Adding assets. Landing page A/B toggles on. CTA options: "Try in Marketplace" vs "Launch Demo". Ops wants parity across partner listing.

kai: ops-bot, rollout window and gating?

ops-bot: Rollout 08:00-08:20 PT. Health gate: listing success rate >= 98% and median page load <800ms over 5m, else rollback to previous bundle. CDN invalidation at T+2m.

sam: Prefer CTA A = "Try in Marketplace". I'll approve unless legal objects.

lina: Noted, pinging legal now. UTMs added: utm_medium=marketplace, utm_source=partner-ecosys, utm_campaign=may_launch.

kai: SI note: connectors in staging hit per-file timeout at ~45s. I updated SI onboarding with chunking and backoff. Partners to run connector smoke at 10:00 PT and paste logs here.

sam: Infra commit for listing: 6b3f2d. ops-bot, will rollback preserve provisioning state?

ops-bot: UI rollback won't revert provisioning records. Manual DB rollback needed for provisioning reversion. Auto-fallback routes to "basic-listing" variant to avoid signup loss.

kai: press-bot, confirm embargo notifications?

press-bot: Partners T-30m via secure share; press distribution at T via PRWire and targeted reporters. Press file: https://files.redwood/co/press-kit/5801249999.zip. No quote edits after embargo lift.

sam: Final go/no-go at 07:30 PT. Post single-word thumbs (yes/no/blocker).

lina: yes

kai: yes

sam: Thanks 1. Escalate any partner blockers to #support during 10:00 smoke tests.
